integrity: The infinite-dimensional limit is proved by an analytic variational argument. The numerical checker tests finite instances and does not certify the limit. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The coefficient is established only for fixed positive derivative order, fixed nonzero two-tap symbol and fixed finite separation. There is no independent audit and no claim of a complete novelty determination. A general spectral-edge theorem for slowly varying Jacobi matrices could subsume this special family.
title: A Gaussian interior-edge correction for two-tap Hardy composition–differentiation operators
